result.detail: Two items from the microarchitecture verification plan were left out on purpose. (1) No axi4_lite_regs.sby formal_spec was submitted. Doing so would make formal.run and formal.cover gating, and the assertion set has not been proven; the properties stay in the RTL under `ifdef FORMAL` as design intent. A follow-up task, or the reviewer, should decide whether to add and prove the .sby, since the interface spec includes req:AXIL-FORMAL. (2) axi4_lite_regs_tb_fail.v was not submitted. A second testbench in the source set would be compiled into the same simulator run alongside the first. Neither omission changes the design's behavior. Both are recorded here so the reviewer of [artifact:prj-b98fe8c3bc.microarchitecture.a1] conformance can see them. Simultaneous read and write traffic is not exercised by the testbench; the spec allows it, but it is not in the required coverage list. Upstream reviews are [evidence:prj-b98fe8c3bc.interface-spec.e1] and [evidence:prj-b98fe8c3bc.microarchitecture.e1]. This work still needs its own independent review_record.
